subject: Payment gateway compliance hold — request for short sandbox supplement
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@pulsehealth.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — small snag with payment gateway verification

Hi Jonas & Vanessa,

Quick update from our side — procurement has started the onboarding for Redwood but the payment gateway (our payments partner) has put a temporary compliance hold on new vendor transactions while they validate our corporate entity details. Procurement says this is an outside-in hold and could take 7–10 business days to clear.

We’ve got engineers ready to run the integration tests and a product demo scheduled next week. If those transactions can’t be processed, our sandbox runs will be limited and the team will lose momentum. Is there a way Redwood can give us a short, timeboxed sandbox supplement (tokens or credits) so the engineering spike and the demo stay on schedule while procurement resolves the gateway check?

I’ve attached our pilot success criteria and a one-page procurement note for context. Thanks — we really want to keep this moving.

Maya Patel
Sr Product Manager | PulseHealth
maya.patel@pulsehealth.ai
+1 415-555-0190

Attachments: pilot-success-criteria.pdf (pdf), procurement-note.docx (docx)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@pulsehealth.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — short sandbox supplement while gateway completes

Thanks for the heads up, Maya — sorry to hear the payments gating is slowing you down. We’ve seen this before with some enterprise gateways.

We can offer a short, conditional supplement to keep the pilot live while your procurement gets the gateway cleared. Before I do that I have two quick asks:
- Confirm approximate duration (your note says 7–10 business days) — we prefer to set an explicit expiration for the supplement.
- Confirm any specific security or audit concerns procurement needs documented (so we can include it in the supplement terms).

I’m attaching a 1-page pilot-plan.xlsx that outlines the suggested token/top-up amounts and the automated expiration policy we’ll use (auto-revoke after X days). If that works I’ll loop in ops and finance for a one-off approval.

Proposed short option: 10,000 token credit, 14-day expiration, no auto-renew. If procurement clears earlier we’ll revert usage to normal billing.

If you’d prefer a smaller top-up we can do that as well — just let me know and I’ll fast-track approvals.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0123

Attachment: pilot-plan.xlsx
